title: This Game Boy Survived a Bombing and Still Played Tetris

scenes.text: This Game Boy survived a bombing and still played Tetris.
It was 1991, during the Gulf War. A US Army soldier kept it in his barracks.
Then the barracks were bombed. Fire burned the front and melted the A and B buttons.
Nintendo tested it with a Tetris cartridge and a battery pack. It worked.
They swapped it for a new one and put the burnt original in their New York store.
A handheld that took a bomb and still ran Tetris.

description:
This Game Boy survived a bombing and still played Tetris.
In 1991 a Game Boy was damaged when barracks were bombed in the Gulf War. Nintendo tested it, and it still worked.
What's the toughest gadget you've ever owned? Comment below.
first_comment: Nintendo swapped the soldier's Game Boy for a new one. Would you have kept the burnt one?
